events.name: good_weather
events.message: Good weather: a rich growing season ahead

events.name: drought
events.message: Drought: harvests will be poor this season

events.name: cold_years
events.message: The sun is veiled: cold summers and failed harvests for two years

events.name: harsh_winter
events.message: Harsh winter: cold weather weakens the village

events.name: forest_fire
events.message: Forest fire: little wood can be cut, and part of the woods is lost

events.name: disease
events.message: Disease outbreak

events.name: plague
events.message: Plague: a deadly epidemic sweeps the village

events.name: army
events.message: An army passes through: soldiers take grain and animals

events.name: raid
events.message: Raiders strike: grain and animals taken, people killed

events.name: debasement
events.message: The ruler debases the coinage: coins are worth less

events.name: wool_slump
events.message: The wool markets abroad are closed: wool fetches less than half its price

events.name: debt_jubilee
events.message: The ruler cancels all debts

events.name: granary_fire
events.message: Fire or pests in the granary: stored food lost

events.name: accident
events.message: Accident or illness
